column2: Take the form of a swan.
Take the form of a bull.
Take the form of an eagle.
The divine body bends before your will. Which guise shall the mortal world behold?
Take the form of a serpent.
Let divine blood enter the mortal world.
The chosen mortal stands before a god hidden beneath another shape.
Let them remember the sound of your hooves.
In the shape of a colossal white bull, you thunder toward your chosen target. Mortal courage buckles before the presence of a god.
Nothing beneath the clouds escapes my gaze.
From the high air you watch roads, halls and courtyards that no mortal spy could observe so freely.
Leave the shadow of Olympus behind.
Silent scales carry you through spaces barred to men. A whisper, a mark, and your presence is gone before anyone understands what entered.
Your divine body contracts and flows into the white shape of a swan. Beneath the feathers the will of Zeus remains unchanged.
Muscle and divine force replace the human silhouette. The earth itself seems smaller beneath your hooves.
Wings open where arms stood a heartbeat before. As the eagle, the world of mortals lies exposed below.
Your form narrows into silent coils. Doors and guards mean little to a god who can move unseen along the floor.
The carved signs shift beneath your gaze. Their meaning can be bent toward one purpose.
Watch my halls. Find plots before they ripen.

The ravens return with more than omens. They bring names whispered behind closed doors, the measure of armies, hidden roads and scraps of forgotten lore. Decide where the Allfather’s sight is needed most.
The old fury rises — not mere anger, but the ecstasy of battle itself.
A hood and a staff are enough to hide even a god from those who only see what they expect.
The old magic coils around your target. This will be no passing ill omen: the curse will sap body, judgment, fertility and strength for years.
Knowledge without sacrifice is shallow. The well asks for what cannot be casually restored.
You know the price of the deepest runes. Even immortal flesh will remember the ordeal.
Bronze rings against bronze. The ancient guardians of Zeus await the command to descend into mortal war.
Beyond the veil, the chosen dead strike shield against shield and wait for the Allfather's blood to call them.
The weapon of Zeus blazes in your hand. Divine lightning can annihilate mortals, wound demigods, but cannot extinguish an intact immortal god.
Legends, broken inscriptions and impossible witnesses point toward a place where the old world may still touch this one.
The Sickle was forged to wound what should not be wound. Against divine blood, its edge seeks something deeper than flesh.
Unite the blood of the Two Thrones.
Zeus and Odin are both complete within you. With the two signature weapons as anchors, the old separation of pantheons might be broken.
For the first time, the blood of Olympus and the blood of the Allfather have fused in one mortal line. Priests call it omen, blasphemy or promise.
A child has been born directly from the FULL blood of two divine traditions. Cults and enemies alike will remember this birth.

A generation of divine descendants has matured into proven heroes. The Age of Heroes has begun: active adult demigods gain a lasting heroic-era bonus, and established heroes face trials more frequently.
The living heads of Zeus and Odin now stand on opposite sides of war. Their followers see more than a mortal quarrel.
Olympus and the northern heavens have found common cause. The mortal world watches an alliance no priest expected to witness.
Kouretes and Einherjar march in the same war on opposing sides. Legends that once belonged to different worlds now collide.
The four divine components have been joined by will rather than chance. The old order of the gods can no longer remain untouched.
For a heartbeat the sky falls silent. Thunder no longer answers its first lord: the true Zeus has left the world. Every carrier of his blood feels the rupture, and Olympus enters an age of heirs.

The ravens fall silent and ancient runes seem to dim. The true Odin has left the world. His blood feels the emptiness where the Allfather's voice once stood, and Valhalla waits for a new keeper of the inheritance.
Divine blood does not permit abandoning its ancestral faith.
The terrible protection of Olympus, an emblem of divine authority and near-impregnable defence.
Food of the gods. In this mod it is one of the keys to restoring immortality severed by Cronus' Sickle.
A fruit of renewed divine life. It is required for Odin's line to restore severed immortality.
Choose one of Zeus' four animal forms. The form changes the portrait and unlocks its own actions until you return to the true form.
The four divine components have been deliberately joined by ritual. This being is no longer merely a descendant of one pantheon.
Charge into the target's presence in the form of the divine bull and break their nerve.
As legitimate FULL head of Odin's line, open the way from Valhalla. Their number scales with age: 2,000 / 4,000 / 7,000 / 12,000 / 20,000.
As legitimate FULL head of Zeus' line, call the immortal guardians of Olympus. Their number scales with age: 2,000 / 4,000 / 7,000 / 12,000 / 20,000.

Lay a powerful three-year Seidr curse on another character, crippling health, fertility, combat ability and all major attributes. Intact gods receive a divine-safe version that cannot bypass immortality through health loss.
Born directly from FULL representatives of Zeus and Odin, this child stands at the center of cults, prophecies and dynastic struggle.
A 250-year-old legitimate bearer of Zeus P/M and Odin P/M may attempt the supreme convergence ritual while holding the two signature weapons.
Active divine blood preserves fertility and vitality beyond mortal age limits.
A true god cannot be killed by an ordinary mortal plot or duel. The Adamantine Sickle of Cronus is required to break divine protection.
Visit an adult woman while wearing one of Zeus' divine forms. Any child follows the normal P/M inheritance rules.
Odin's golden ring, an emblem of inexhaustible wealth, kingship and sacred prestige.
Circle above the target as Zeus' eagle and study their court from the sky.
Odin P has met Zeus M. Prophecy, intrigue and heavenly authority mingle in this hybrid line.
Travel under a mortal guise in search of secrets, wealth and knowledge.
Odin's spear, bearer of oaths and certainty in battle. Its wielder gains terrifying martial and prophetic authority.
The Helm of Darkness hides its bearer from the sight of mortals and gods. It is granted to Zeus' created brother Hades at campaign start.
Send Huginn and Muninn across the world, then choose whether their knowledge will guard your court, scout war, or deepen your wisdom for one year.
Strike a target of any age with Zeus Thunderbolt. Mortal: 35% death / 65% severe wound, demigod: 15% / 85%, divine-judgment survivor: 10% / 90%, an intact true god cannot be killed. Cooldown: 1 year.
Mark a worthy adult warrior as bound for Valhalla.
The divine mead of inspiration, eloquence and wisdom.

MATERNAL COMPONENT OF ODIN (M). The half associated with fate, memory, wisdom and the Norns passes ONLY from the biological mother. A man may carry M but cannot transmit it as a father. FULL blood appears only when the child actually receives Odin P from the father and Odin M from the mother

PATERNAL COMPONENT OF ODIN (P). The Allfather's inheritance of war, will, runes and Valhalla passes ONLY from the biological father. Odin carries both P and M, but as a father transmits only P. An ordinary wife, concubine or lover without Odin M cannot produce a FULL child with him. If the mother truly supplies Odin M, the child becomes FULL regardless of legitimacy. Repeated mortal marriages weaken demigod branches into faded and latent blood.
Enter Odin's terrible battle-fury for a time, at the risk of bodily injury.
An immortal Olympian deity in his own right. This status is used for the canonical brothers of Zeus and is not inherited as Zeus blood.
Sacrifice an eye for permanent wisdom. Odin himself already bears this price.
Restore the Secret of Eternal Life
Restore the Secret of Eternal Life.
Discard the current animal form and reveal Zeus exactly as he appeared before transforming.
Open an event and choose what the runes shall reveal: war, plots, rule or fate.
Forbidden runic knowledge won at terrible cost, opening the deepest mysteries of fate and sorcery.
A symbol of heavenly kingship, inspiring obedience, prestige and sacred authority.
Slip unseen into the target's surroundings in serpent form and leave a divine mark.
The Adamantine Sickle of Cronus has cut the bond between divine blood and eternal life. The blood remains, but natural death can claim this god unless immortality is restored.

A unique anti-divine weapon. The first successful strike severs immortality without removing divine blood, a second can end a severed god forever. At campaign start it is placed into mortal hands, never into Zeus' or Odin's inventory.
Challenge a God with the Sickle of Cronus

Challenge any true god within diplomatic reach of the world map to a real duel while wielding the Sickle. A lethal-quality victory against an intact god severs immortality instead of killing, a later lethal victory can kill the already-severed god.
Zeus P has met Odin M. Thunder answers runes in this hybrid blood, creating a mortal but formidable bridge between Olympus and the North.
The sovereign weapon of the sky-father. It crackles with divine lightning and answers most fiercely to the blood of Zeus.
Draw the power of Zeus' Thunderbolt into yourself for 180 days, increasing martial skill and personal combat ability.
Poseidon's canonical weapon and symbol of dominion over sea, storms and earthquakes. It is granted to Zeus' created brother Poseidon at campaign start.
Attempt the highest runic ordeal. Success grants permanent mastery, failure can maim even a god.

MATERNAL COMPONENT OF ZEUS (M). The life-bearing half of Olympian divinity passes ONLY from the biological mother. A man may carry M, but he cannot transmit it as a father. A father possessing both Zeus P and Zeus M does not automatically give both to his children. Thus a child of Zeus and an ordinary wife, concubine or lover without Zeus M receives only P. If the mother truly carries M and the father supplies P, legitimacy is irrelevant: the child is FULL.

PATERNAL COMPONENT OF ZEUS (P). The spark of thunder, sovereignty and Olympian power passes ONLY from the biological father. Marriage type, concubinage, adultery and bastardy do not alter this rule. Zeus himself carries both P and M, but as a father he transmits only P. If the mother does not carry Zeus M, the child cannot become FULL. If the father supplies Zeus P and the mother truly supplies Zeus M, FULL blood awakens even in a bastard. Repeated unions of demigods with ordinary mortals weaken the branch until the blood becomes latent.

Only one component of Odin is present. The character is mortal but long-lived and gifted in war, knowledge or intrigue, at adulthood the blood manifests as a random northern aspect. This character can help restore FULL blood in later generations.

The Allfather's blood has weakened through repeated mortal unions. Its runic force may sink into a latent state, yet ancient inheritance does not always disappear forever and can reawaken generations later.
Select this only for the ruler who must become Odin when the campaign begins. His name, Norse culture, Germanic pagan faith, divine blood and canonical wife Frigg will be created automatically.

Both components of Odin have truly united in this character: P came from the father and M from the mother. Bastardy does not prevent FULL if both components were actually inherited. FULL blood awakens immortality, resistance to disease and bodily decline, century-based growth, runic powers and authority over Valhalla. An ordinary mortal without the Sickle of Cronus should have no plot or duel path to kill such a god.

Both components of Zeus have truly united in this character: P came through the father and M through the mother. Legitimacy does not matter. FULL blood awakens immortality at adulthood, resists disease, frailty and incapacity, grows stronger over centuries, and opens the highest powers of Olympus. An ordinary mortal cannot kill such a god by plot or duel without the Sickle of Cronus.

Only one component of Zeus is present. The character is mortal but unnaturally healthy, strong and long-lived, at adulthood the blood manifests as a random heroic aspect. This character can help restore FULL blood in later generations.
The divine component no longer manifests as a full bloodline. Too many generations have mixed with mortals. Without renewed union with a god or demigod, the inheritance becomes latent

Select this only for the ruler who must become Zeus when the campaign begins. His name, Greek culture, Hellenic faith, divine blood, canonical wife Hera and brothers Poseidon and Hades will be created automatically.
This character achieved the nearly impossible: capturing and holding a true god. Mortals admire the feat, while gods remember the insult.
The first mortal or demigod to kill a true god with Cronus' Sickle. The deed changed the blood of the killer's descendants forever.
Descendants of the first true Godslayer can challenge divine immortality without Cronus' Sickle.
Sacred Goal: Dominion of the Faith
Use the swan form to disappear among mortals and gain temporary secrecy.
Manifest the bull's divine fury during war.
Circle the realm as an eagle and improve plot discovery.
Use the serpent form to slip into places inaccessible to men and gather secrets.
Call on the Valkyries for a temporary battle blessing.
Awaken Draupnir and gain wealth and prestige.
Call Odin's eight-legged steed. While imprisoned, this gives a strong chance to escape.
Follow ancient clues to the lost adamantine Sickle, the weapon capable of severing a true god's immortality.
Make restoration and reformation of the Hellenic faith a divine goal. Taking the vow grants strong claims on all five Hellenic holy sites. After reformation, pursue its spread and dominion.
Vow to Restore the Allfather's Faith
Make restoration and reformation of the Germanic faith a divine goal. Taking the vow grants strong claims on all five Germanic holy sites. After reformation, spread it across Midgard.
Appear before a chosen character in the divine swan form.
Charge a chosen character in the form of the heavenly bull.
Appear as a heavenly eagle and grant a sign.
Infiltrate the target as a serpent and mark them for intrigue.
Poison a mortal or demigod in serpent form. An intact true god cannot be targeted.
Send Huginn and Muninn to a specific character. For one year the target suffers exposed secrets
column3: if that character is currently plotting, the ravens reveal the plot to you. You also gain a dossier that improves your intrigue and plot power.

column2: Cast Gungnir at a target of any age. Mortal: 30% death / 70% severe wound, demigod: 12% / 88%, divine-judgment survivor: 8% / 92%, an intact true god cannot be killed. Cooldown: 1 year.
Bind the target with a runic sacred oath for 3 years. Costs 100 Piety. The target gains the Sacred Oath modifier and +25 opinion of Odin, Odin power cooldown: 180 days.
Mark a chosen character with protective and martial runes.
Share the Mead of Poetry and empower a chosen character.
Godslayer blood can challenge a true god without the Sickle. Success bypasses divine immortality, but failure is dangerous.
Attempt to deal with a true god in your prison. Without the Sickle or Godslayer blood, the god survives.
The transformation changes the visible animal form without replacing the character's human identity, culture or origin.
The transformation changes the visible animal form without replacing the character's human identity, culture or origin.
The transformation changes the visible animal form without replacing the character's human identity, culture or origin.
The transformation changes the visible animal form without replacing the character's human identity, culture or origin.
In the form of a swan, the boundary between beauty and miracle becomes a weapon. You can leave the target enchanted by an encounter with a creature carrying the will of Olympus.
Let this form never be forgotten.
The ground trembles beneath your hooves. In this form Zeus does not hide his strength — he turns it into a blow capable of breaking a mortal and shaking even a demigod.
The eagle circles above the chosen one. To some it promises glory, to others it is a warning that the heavens are watching.
Let them remember the gaze of Olympus.
The serpent passes through cracks and dark rooms where guards are useless. A few overheard words can be worth more than an army.
One bite, and what spreads through the target's blood is no ordinary venom, but a fragment of the Thunderer's will.
Let the venom do its work.
The impossible has become fact: a true god is in your hands. Ordinary bars do not make such a being mortal, but the capture itself will enter legend.
Let the world remember who accomplished this.
Locks, walls and guards prove insufficient. Divine power finds an opening where a mortal would see only stone and iron.
A captive god stands before you. Ordinary execution cannot end this life. Everything depends on whether you bear the Sickle of Cronus or the blood of the first Godslayer.

Huginn and Muninn return from the target’s court with names, routes, habits and whispered plans. If the target was weaving an active plot, the ravens expose it. Their dossier remains useful for a full year.
Nothing is hidden from the Allfather.
Gungnir rests in your hand, bound to oath and inevitability. If you cast it, a mortal may die outright, one who survives will be grievously wounded.
Runes flare as the chosen one speaks the oath. Breaking these words will now be more than politics — it will be sacrilege.
You trace runes of protection, strength and clarity over the chosen one. Their power is not eternal, but while the marks remain fresh, fate is kinder.
The Mead of Poetry touches the chosen one's lips. Words gain force, memory sharpens, and ordinary speech begins to sound like a skald's song.
The Allfather's eight-legged steed answers the call. Neither road, guard nor ordinary wall seems quite so final with Sleipnir beneath you.

For the first time, a true god has fallen forever by a hand of the mortal world. The Sickle of Cronus proved that eternity can be severed, and the killer's blood has changed forever. From this day there is a lineage even gods may fear.
The blood of the first Godslayer answers the challenge. This will be resolved as a real duel: victory can kill even an intact true god, while failure can still destroy the challenger.
Face the god in mortal combat.

Your divine blood alone does not make a legend. Experience, reputation and ambition have finally brought you to the point where a heroic path can be chosen. Each path permanently shapes how this demigod develops.
Fate again demands a deed worthy of divine blood. The path you chose suggests how you will answer.
Protect those who cannot protect themselves.
Your deeds are already retold as legend. People leave offerings, tell children of your exploits, and begin to see in you more than a bearer of divine blood.
A demigod around whom a true cult had formed has left the world of the living. Death did not erase the name: songs, shrines and stories will preserve the hero's memory.
The first demigod of Zeus' line has been born. The divine blood of Olympus now flows through a child who remains mortal, yet no longer belongs wholly to mankind.
The first demigod of Odin's line has been born. Above the cradle one can almost hear distant ravens, and mortals begin to understand that the blood of old gods lives among them again.
A New God Walks the World
For the first time since the founders arrived, a new true god has been born. This is no merely powerful descendant: both sides of divine blood joined and awakened true immortality.
A line thought almost dissolved among mortals has unexpectedly produced active divine blood again. The old legends were not dead — they were waiting for a generation.
There are now too many divine descendants to dismiss as rare wonders. Courts discuss marriages with demigods, priests argue over omens, and rulers build policy around the blood of gods.
A World of Gods and Mortals

Gods, demigods and their celebrated descendants have become a permanent part of politics. The world can no longer be divided between ordinary people and distant myths: myths live, wage war, marry and rule beside mortals.

With true gods walking the world, the oldest myth is remembered again: Gaia gave Cronus an adamant Sickle capable of wounding divine nature itself. After the fall of the Titans, the weapon vanished. No one knows where it lies now.
Then somewhere there is a weapon against gods.
Old temple lists and fragments of songs point toward the route by which the relic may have been carried after the fall of the Titans. The search will be long and costly.
The trail leads to a long-abandoned sanctuary. Among the ruins are signs of Cronus, but no certainty whether they lead to the relic or another legend.
Deep within the hiding place lies a weapon whose metal has not dulled with age. If the old stories are true, this is the Sickle of Cronus itself.
The Sickle of Cronus Is Found
The lost adamant Sickle has appeared in the world again. To mortals it is hope and temptation. To true gods it is news that a weapon exists which can sever their immortality.
The search yielded only ancient debris and empty legends. The Sickle remains lost, and another trail will have to wait for years.
The Hellenic faith has been reformed. For the gods of Olympus this is not the end of the journey, but the beginning of a new goal: spread the restored faith far beyond its ancient holy places.
The Germanic faith has been reformed. The old gods no longer accept mere survival among foreign cults: their gaze now turns toward all Midgard.
A hidden trace of the weakened paternal side of Zeus' blood.
A hidden trace of the weakened maternal side of Zeus' blood.
A hidden trace of the weakened paternal side of Odin's blood.
A hidden trace of the weakened maternal side of Odin's blood.
The paternal legacy of Zeus is nearly dormant, but may reawaken in descendants.
The maternal legacy of Zeus is nearly dormant, but may reawaken in descendants.
The paternal legacy of Odin is nearly dormant, but may reawaken in descendants.
The maternal legacy of Odin is nearly dormant, but may reawaken in descendants.
A hidden system ward preventing normal old-age events from bypassing special divine mortality rules.
Hidden marker for the divine swan portrait.
Hidden marker for the divine bull portrait.
Hidden marker for the divine eagle portrait.
Hidden marker for the divine serpent portrait.
You will gain strong claims on all five holy sites of this faith.
The sacred goal binds a god to restoring the old faith and grants strong claims on its five holy sites.

A secret mortal brotherhood that studies divine blood, seeks the Sickle of Cronus and prepares traps for immortals. Membership alone never grants the power to kill an intact true god: the Sickle or an active Godslayer Bloodline is still required.
Lower members of the Order tend to obey the Masters of the Sickle.
Spend Secret Knowledge to study a god or demigod. Repeated successful operations improve the Order’s intelligence on the target.
Organize a hunt against an active demigod. The target may be wounded, captured or killed. True-god immunity does not apply to demigods.
Attempt to steal a random divine artifact from the target. Stealing the Sickle is much harder and requires Executioner rank.
Build a temporary network of informants, bait and restraints around a studied true god. A prepared trap improves capture chances during a Grand Hunt.
Spend Order resources to search for the Sickle. If it has already been recovered, agents will try to identify its current holder.
Launch a coordinated operation against a studied true god. Without the Sickle or the Godslayer Bloodline, the Order can only attempt capture.
Arrest a revealed Order member in your realm and destroy part of the society’s accumulated Secret Knowledge.
The agent network must lie low before another major operation.
The Order needs time to rebuild its agents, safe houses and contacts.
Wounds suffered in a clash with the Order of the Sickle.
Traces of the Order’s activity have become known to its enemies.
Active divine blood has returned. The Order of the Sickle will not keep a renewed demigod or true god among its members.
Agents are ready to study the target’s habits, ancestry and entourage.
The watchers return with useful intelligence. The Order’s dossier on the target has become much more complete.
The operation failed. Some watchers barely escaped, and traces may have exposed the cell.
A demigod is more dangerous than any mortal, but does not possess the inviolability of an intact true god. The hunters are ready.
Agents will infiltrate the owner’s circle and attempt to carry away one divine artifact.
The operation succeeded. A divine artifact has fallen into your hands.
The guards were more alert than expected. The agents returned empty-handed, and their traces may lead back to the Order.
Safe houses, bribed servants, false routes and prepared restraints form a temporary trap around the chosen god.
The Sickle of Cronus is already in mortal hands. The Order’s network has narrowed the search and marked its known holder.
The Order’s network moves as one. If you possess a legitimate way to break immortality, this may become a god-killing. Without one, the operation can only end in capture or failure.
Something ancient has touched the world. You sense a weapon made against immortals: the legend of the Sickle of Cronus has awakened again. To a true god this is not a mortal tale, but a warning.
Divine instinct confirms the worst: the Sickle of Cronus is no longer merely a legend. The weapon has been found and rests in living hands.
Find it before it finds me.
Immortality has proven less than absolute. A true god has died, and every pantheon now knows that mortals have found a path to divine blood.
The heavens will remember this day.

The sky splits beneath a storm no mortal weather could summon. Zeus has entered the world openly and seized a foothold in Epirus. Two thousand warriors gather behind him, the first army of his new divine realm.
Olympus now has a foothold among mortals.

Ravens gather beneath a darkened sky and old runes seem to stir in stone and wood. Odin has entered the world openly and seized Uppland. Two thousand warriors stand beneath his banners, ready to expand the All-Father’s earthly domain.
Asgard now has a foothold on earth.
A true god exerts a supernatural social and romantic pull that transcends mortal religions.
Active divine blood makes this demigod unusually magnetic to mortals of every faith.
Direct descent from one of the independent Olympian gods. The blood is strong, but fades through repeated mortal unions.
The divine spark in this branch has weakened, but may reawaken generations later.
A marriage involving a true god or active demigod can be proposed across faiths without the interfaith block. It works only within normal diplomatic range and is never auto-initiated by AI.
The proposal comes from one whose blood stands above mortal religious prohibitions. Such a union can bind dynasties that ordinary custom would keep apart.
Members of the Order of the Sickle deliberately suppress reverence and attraction toward gods and demigods.

Zeus no longer remains an abstract Manifestation of Olympus. He takes a county in Epirus, becomes an independent territorial ruler, and gathers two thousand warriors beneath his banner for the wars to come.
Let mortals behold the Thunderer’s rule.
Odin no longer remains an abstract Manifestation of Asgard. He takes Uppland, becomes an independent territorial ruler, and leads two thousand warriors prepared for new campaigns.
The ravens already circle over his new land.
Born from two full divine traditions. This character is a true god, not a demigod, and carries the divine essences inherited from both parents.
This character survived a direct divine strike, endured the grievous wound it caused, and recovered. Their body and will have become harder to break by later divine intervention.
Agents, scholars and adventurers are following a trail toward a lost divine relic.
Fell before an inescapable divine judgment.
The expedition has returned in triumph. The sought divine relic has been recovered and delivered into your hands.
After months of searching, the expedition returns empty-handed. The clues were false, stale or deliberately obscured.
The Relic Already Has a Bearer
The trail was real, but it ends in the hands of another living owner. The relic is already present in the world and cannot be rediscovered as a second copy.
Study the Order of the Sickle Codex
Review how the Order, its ranks, intelligence network, the Sickle and Godslayer blood actually work.
Review the Order’s current shared intelligence on this divine target.
Codex of the Order of the Sickle

The Order is a small anti-divine network, not a mass religion. Rank I builds dossiers. Rank II hunts demigods and steals relics. Rank III prepares traps and traces the Sickle. Rank IV can launch a Grand Hunt. Intelligence is shared and decays with time. An intact adult true god cannot be killed by ordinary mortals: the Sickle must first sever immortality, while descendants of the first Godslayer can threaten intact gods in real lethal combat.
The Order has no reliable intelligence on this target yet. Observation is required before serious operations become practical.
Dossier Level I: identity, divine status and broad habits are known. Basic surveillance and demigod-hunting operations are possible.
Dossier Level II: routes, household patterns and relic security are understood. Relic theft and preparation of anti-god traps become practical.
Dossier Level III: the target has been studied in depth. A Grand Hunt may be prepared by the highest ranks of the Order.
Dossier Level IV: the Order possesses exceptionally current intelligence on the target, including routines, vulnerabilities and known relic connections.
Several divine lineages mingle in this blood. It is no longer fully divine, but the active essences of both pantheons remain.

column2: The queenly scepter of Hera, a sign of marriage, sovereignty and divine authority on Olympus.
The royal diadem of Hera, marking the dignity of the queen of the Olympians.
Poseidon's divine chariot, drawn by the power of the sea and the god's sacred horses.
The dark royal scepter of Hades, symbol of his unchallenged dominion over the realm below.
The sacred torches of Demeter, carried in the search for Persephone and associated with the mysteries of grain and rebirth.
A divine horn of plenty representing Demeter's bounty, harvest and the fruitfulness of the earth.
The undying flame of the sacred hearth, guarded by Hestia as the center of home, kin and ordered life.
The solemn veil of Hestia, a regalia of purity, hearth and divine peace.
Frigg's sacred distaff, recalling her association with spinning, household rule and the hidden pattern of fate.
The keys of Frigg's hall Fensalir, symbols of household authority, guardianship and the secrets kept by the All-Mother.
The sky tears open. The Thunderbolt of Zeus strikes with impossible force, and you know that the divine judgment has found its mark.
The Thunderbolt of Zeus crashes into you with enough force to erase a mortal life. Your intact divinity refuses death, but even a god is left grievously wounded.
The Thunderbolt of Zeus strikes you. You survive the divine blow, but your body is left grievously wounded.
The spear of the All-Father crosses the distance as though fate itself had thrown it. Gungnir finds you, and the wound is mortal.
Gungnir finds its mark. The blow would kill a mortal, yet your intact divinity denies death. The spear still leaves a grievous wound.
Gungnir finds its mark. You remain alive, but the divine spear leaves you grievously wounded.
An unseen pressure settles over you. Thought grows heavy, strength drains away and the threads of fate seem to knot around your life. A god has laid Seidr upon you.
The grievous wound is finally gone. You did more than survive a god's direct judgment: you healed from it. Something in body and spirit has hardened against the touch of divine power.
Your Thunderbolt delivered its judgment. The target did not survive.
Your Thunderbolt struck true. The target survived, but only with a grievous wound.
Your Thunderbolt struck a true god. Divine nature prevented death, but the target was grievously wounded.
Gungnir found its mark, and the target fell to the divine spear.
Gungnir found its mark. The target survived, grievously wounded.
Gungnir struck a true god. It could not extinguish intact divinity, but it left a grievous wound.
Your Seidr has settled over the target. The curse will gnaw at body, mind and fortune for years.
Execute the god with Godslayer blood.
Finish the severed god with the Sickle.
Raise the Sickle and sever immortality.
The age of myth is returning.
Myth and history are one world now.
Too late — the Sickle is no longer here.
The age of invulnerable gods is over.
Olympus will be heard across the world.
Let Midgard hear the old gods.
At last, the relic is mine.
Then another bearer already holds it.
Your proposal has been accepted. The divine union is now sealed.
So the two lines are joined.
